folder.instructions: Which folder does this email belong in?

Work.what: My current job: projects, colleagues, meetings, work tools
Work.not_for: Recruiting, job offers or applications (use Jobs)

Jobs.what: Recruiters, job alerts, job applications, interviews
examples: X busca personal para el puesto de...

Finance.not_for: Tax agency or traffic authority (use Tax)

Tax.what: Tax and government notices: tax returns, fines, official notifications

House.what: Finding, buying, selling or renting a home

Shopping.what: Orders, shipping, buying and selling on marketplaces

examples: You shared Google account data with an app

criteria.Other: None of the above clearly fits

needs_reply.instructions: Does the sender expect a personal reply from me?

priority.instructions: How soon must I personally act on this email? Ignore marketing, sales or fundraising urgency.

job_stage.instructions: If this email is about my job search, what stage is it?

criteria.Alert: Job alerts, job recommendations, profile views
criteria.Outreach: A recruiter or company contacts me first about a role
criteria.Applied: Confirmation that my application was received or viewed
criteria.Interview: Interview invitation, scheduling, assessment or test
